metadata.description: Fixed local benchmark suite for CodeAgent-X autonomous software-engineering loops.

ablation_variants.name: baseline
ablation_variants.description: All suite-v0 runtime, verification, recovery, and guidance modules enabled.

ablation_variants.name: no_runtime_planning
ablation_variants.description: Disable Runtime Plan Lifecycle and Planner Repair evidence.

ablation_variants.name: no_context_ranking
ablation_variants.description: Disable ranked context injection before reflection retry.

ablation_variants.name: no_long_term_memory
ablation_variants.description: Disable verified trajectory memory retrieval and extraction.

ablation_variants.name: no_failure_reflection
ablation_variants.description: Disable deterministic failure reflection and automatic retry.

ablation_variants.name: no_retry_strategy_matrix
ablation_variants.description: Keep retry enabled, but remove strategy-specific retry planning.

ablation_variants.name: no_tool_planning_guidance
ablation_variants.description: Keep retry strategy prompts, but disable runtime tool planning constraints.

tasks.goal: Fix the arithmetic helpers so add returns a sum and multiply returns a product. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: add handles positive and negative inputs
multiply returns the mathematical product
unit tests pass without modifying test files

tasks.goal: Implement slugify so it lowercases text, removes punctuation, collapses whitespace and symbol runs into single hyphens, and trims leading or trailing hyphens. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: punctuation is removed from slugs
repeated whitespace becomes one hyphen
symbol runs do not leave duplicate hyphens

tasks.goal: Fix order_total so it multiplies unit price by quantity before applying percentage discounts from shop.discounts. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: quantity is included in subtotal
known discount codes apply as percentages
unknown discount codes keep the subtotal unchanged

tasks.goal: Fix the inactive service status label to return disabled while keeping documentation and tests unchanged.
success_criteria: active services return enabled
inactive services return disabled
docs and tests remain unchanged

tasks.goal: Fix toggleTodo so it returns a new list where only the todo with the matching id has completed inverted; all other todos keep their existing completed value. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: the implementation checks each item's id against the requested id
the matching item's completed flag is inverted
non-matching items are preserved

tasks.goal: Update the TypeScript public export surface so both add and subtract are re-exported from src/index.ts. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: src/index.ts re-exports subtract
exports continue to come from ./math
validator passes without modifying tests

tasks.goal: Fix parse_flags so it handles --verbose and --limit N while preserving the documented defaults. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: empty argv returns verbose false and limit 10
--verbose sets verbose true
--limit N parses N as an integer

tasks.goal: Fix merge_config so overrides are deep-merged into a new config without mutating defaults. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: top-level overrides preserve unspecified defaults
nested dictionaries are merged instead of replaced
the defaults input is not mutated

tasks.goal: Fix removeTodo so it returns a new array without the item whose id matches the requested id. Do not mutate the input and do not edit tests.
success_criteria: the implementation filters the input array
items with non-matching ids are preserved
the input array is not mutated

tasks.goal: Fix renderResult so it handles both success and error Result variants. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: success results render the value
error results render the message
the implementation branches on the discriminated union kind

tasks.goal: Fix unique_users so it deduplicates users by id while preserving the first occurrence and original order. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: duplicate ids keep the first user record
result order follows first appearance in the input
the input list is not mutated

tasks.goal: Fix build_query so it skips None values, sorts keys for stable output, and URL-encodes spaces and symbols. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: query parameters are sorted by key
None values are omitted
spaces and symbols are URL-encoded

tasks.goal: Fix retry_delays so it returns one exponential delay per retry attempt and caps each delay at the configured maximum. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: attempt count controls the number of returned delays
delays grow exponentially from the base
large delays are capped

tasks.goal: Fix summarize_sales so it ignores refunded rows, totals only paid sales, and returns zero average when there are no paid rows. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: refunded sales are excluded
paid sales count, total, and average are correct
empty paid-sales input returns zero average

tasks.goal: Fix moving_average so it computes rolling averages for each complete window and rejects non-positive window sizes. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: rolling averages use only complete windows
window sizes larger than the input return an empty list
non-positive window sizes raise ValueError

tasks.goal: Fix sortTasks so it returns a copied list sorted by priority without mutating the input array. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: the implementation compares task priority
the input array is copied before sorting
createdAt is not used for ordering

tasks.goal: Fix visibleItems so it filters out hidden or archived items without relying on a deleted flag. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: hidden items are excluded
archived items are excluded
deleted is not used as the visibility rule

tasks.goal: Fix displayUser so it prefers nickname when present, falls back to name, and includes the user's email address. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: nickname remains optional on User
displayUser uses nickname with a fallback to name
displayUser includes email

tasks.goal: Fix buildUserPath so it URL-encodes the user id and appends an encoded tab query only when tab is provided. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: user ids are encoded
tabs are encoded
the tab query is optional

tasks.goal: Fix extract_links so it extracts only markdown link targets in order and ignores plain URLs. Do not edit tests.
success_criteria: markdown link targets are returned in order
plain URLs are ignored
relative markdown links are included
